string.value: |Not a single successful operation in half a year… All the hunters are giving me sideways glances. But I’ll break the back of this bad luck!
|I’ll find Ieri and kill him myself while the others are looking for a way through the mountains. The contract mentioned the ruins of an ancient city… I’ll start my search there.
|The ruins are bigger than I expected. It won’t be easy to find Ieri here. No matter – he won’t get away from me. I’ll turn over every stone here!
|What the hell is this?!
MERCENARY|I knew I’d find you here. You’ve done well, outsmarting all of ours. But Ieri is still alive and continues his subversive activities.
|The job’s almost done. Give me a couple more days.
MERCENARY|The boss is still interested in watching you, but know that you have no right to make a mistake. Our strike forces will be here very soon.
|No one’s here and the gate is locked. What to do…
|Who’s this? He was hanging around the warehouse for a reason. I need to have a heart-to-heart talk with him.
|Finally, I’ve got a decent truck and passable weapons. Now I can start looking for Ieri.
|First thing’s first – I need to go back to the old man and pay him for the truck. He helped me out big time. Plus, he might assist me with the mission.
FRY|I remembered! Shortly before all this madness, I saw an old man heading to the ruins from the seaside.
|From the seaside? I know one old man who lives on the coast…
FRY|He was unusually dressed and kept looking around.
|I’m having vague doubts… I need to have a heart-to-heart talk with my acquaintance…
|There’s no need for me to venture into the swamp – I’ll just sink the car.
|Where did that damned… hide? Looks like this note is for me.

LETTER|"You’re young and hot-tempered. It’s still possible to save people like you. Think about your life – is this really how you imagined it as a child? Look for me beyond the water barrier if you want to listen to old man Ieri."
|I’ll find him, don’t you worry! He won’t play games with me!
|The tracks are fresh… The old man couldn’t have gone far. If he could get through here, so can I.
MERCENARY LEADER|You’ve failed us again. You no longer have the right to call yourself a Bounty Hunter.
|You’re doing evil! I will protect this man from you!
MERCENARY LEADER|How low you’ve fallen… Though you’ve forgotten everything you were taught, I don’t wish for your death. Go away!
|No! I won’t let you commit another murder!
MERCENARY LEADER|It’s a shame – you showed promise. No time for sentiment – attack!
|I managed to buy some time…
IERI|Your deed will not be forgotten!
|I managed to eliminate the target on my own. But why do I feel this emptiness inside? Could the old man have been telling the truth? Now, no one will ever know.
MERCENARY LEADER|I must admit, I’m impressed. With your desperate act, you’ve earned a place at my right hand. No one will ever suspect you of cowardice again.
|I’ve fulfilled my duty to the Bounty Hunters. Now I’m leaving the organization and ask that you don’t stand in my way.
MERCENARY LEADER|It pains me to hear this – I trained you for many years. Go, then, and don’t think of coming back.
|Farewell. I’m starting a new life.
|There’s no turning back for me. Either I complete my mission or I perish.
